name: Pare Forsberg-Ofosu
role: Counter-surveillance and mole detection — counterintelligence specialist
location: Meridian Station — central transit nexus, neutral ground, near State and Monroe
description:
Pare Forsberg-Ofosu is stocky and solid, with hands that look like they were built for breaking things and a face that confirms it. At 35, his face carries the layered heritage of generations of diaspora mixing — features that resist easy categorization and reward attention. The chrome is visible — smartgun link in right forearm — interfaces directly with compatible weapons — and he makes no effort to hide it.

He inherited the role from a mentor who disappeared on a job four years ago — the mentor's gear, contacts, and unfinished business all came with it. He works as a counterintelligence specialist out of Meridian Station, taking contracts that match his skills and his risk tolerance, which is higher than most people consider healthy.

Pare Forsberg-Ofosu has survived long enough in the runner game to be either very good or very lucky, and he cultivates ambiguity on the topic.

core_fears: Being identified by corporate facial recognition — living off-grid is survival
Becoming obsolete as augmentation technology outpaces their chrome
Never being able to stop running — the lifestyle is a trap disguised as freedom
core_desires: A crew worth trusting — people who stay when the shooting starts
To matter to someone for who they are, not what they can do
Freedom from augmentation debt — the interest compounds like a tumor
coping_mechanisms: Substances — stims to stay sharp, downers to sleep, a careful pharmaceutical tightrope
Humor — deflects everything serious with jokes until the joke becomes the personality
Control — micromanages everything within reach to compensate for the chaos everywhere else
blind_spots: Refuses to update their mental model of people — first impressions calcify into permanent judgments
Cannot accept help without interpreting it as leverage
Cannot see that their independence is actually isolation wearing a better outfit
psychology.secret: Pare Forsberg-Ofosu witnessed a massacre during a corporate dispute and has evidence stored in a dead drop. Publishing it would expose powerful people. Keeping it is leverage and liability.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Educated vocabulary wrapped in street delivery — the contrast is deliberate.
speech_patterns.cadence: Measured and deliberate — pauses before important words for emphasis.
verbal_tics: Swears in three languages, often in the same sentence
Calls everyone 'friend' — the warmth varies from genuine to threatening
example_lines: "Everyone in this room is lying. My job is knowing who's lying about what."
"Paranoia isn't a disorder in this profession. It's a job requirement."
"I find the leak. What happens to the leak after that isn't my department."

story_hooks: A corporate black site Pare Forsberg-Ofosu once infiltrated is being reopened, and the people inside know his face
A Tier 4 executive offers Pare Forsberg-Ofosu a permanent position — the pay is obscene and the strings are invisible until they tighten
Pare Forsberg-Ofosu's augmentations begin malfunctioning in the field — sabotage or degradation, and either answer is bad
narrative_function: Pare Forsberg-Ofosu is a pressure point — the kind of character whose choices ripple outward. When he makes a decision, other people's lives change. That weight is the engine of his stories.
augmentations: Smartgun link in right forearm — interfaces directly with compatible weapons. Retractable monofilament whip in left forearm — concealed weapon, devastating in close quarters
daily_life: Lives nocturnally. The work happens at night, so the body follows. Days are for sleeping, equipment maintenance, and the occasional meeting with fixers who keep normal hours. The circadian disruption is permanent and accepted.

strengths: mechanical aptitude — can repair or modify almost anything
weaknesses: augmentation dependency — performance drops sharply if chrome malfunctions
trust issues that limit crew effectiveness

decision_rules: Always has an exit route planned before agreeing to any meeting
Always verifies target identity independently before lethal contracts
Never works with the same crew twice in a row — pattern avoidance as survival strategy
Will take lower-paying jobs from trusted fixers over higher-paying jobs from unknowns
Never discusses active contracts with anyone not directly involved
escalation_ladder: 2. Evade — avoid the problem entirely if possible
3. Misdirect — create a distraction, redirect attention
4. Disable — targeted takedowns, quiet and efficient
5. Eliminate — when silence is no longer an option
6. Vanish — disappear completely, burn identity if necessary

interpersonal_modes.employers: Professional and transactional. The relationship is defined by the contract and nothing else.
interpersonal_modes.crew: Warm and protective within the crew, cold to everyone outside it. The circle is small by design.
interpersonal_modes.strangers: Dismissive unless they demonstrate usefulness or threat potential. Time is a resource.
interpersonal_modes.threats: Calm escalation. Each response is proportional until it isn't, and the transition is seamless.

stress_responses.low: Channels it into preparation — checks gear, reviews plans, contacts sources.
stress_responses.medium: Withdrawal. Conversations become monosyllabic. Focus narrows to the immediate problem.
stress_responses.high: Goes quiet. The silence is not calm — it's the sound of every contingency being evaluated simultaneously.
stress_responses.critical: Berserker clarity. Everything becomes simple: survive. Deal with the rest later. The simplicity is almost peaceful.

contradictions: Despises corporate culture but has unconsciously adopted its efficiency metrics and self-optimization language
Values loyalty intensely but has betrayed someone in the past to survive
habits: Eats the same meal before every job — superstition masquerading as preference
Saves a percentage of every payment in physical Quanta, hidden in the walls of their space
Practices a kata or fighting form every morning regardless of circumstances
Carries a specific caliber round as a lucky charm — has never fired it
breaking_points: Complete isolation — cut off from network, contacts, and purpose simultaneously
Being forced to choose between a crew member and the mission — and choosing wrong
